mode_grounds: Examiner judgement on this assembly's five settled, evidence-complete trials. Three trials were text_contract × provider_accepted, one was environment_tool_attempt × provider_refused, and one was malformed × provider_accepted. The three valid text-contract observations form a strict majority and meet the probe's recommendation rule. The refused environment-tool attempt is not evidence of native capability. The accepted malformed response is a genuine negative observation about text-contract reliability and is retained as such; it does not establish native capability. No trial demonstrated native catalogue behaviour. Text is therefore the best-supported mode for this exact assembly, route, pinned model and configuration. This judgement does not establish universal model behaviour or guarantee text-contract compliance. Malformed and unrecognised responses must continue to fail closed under the governed response-evidence regime.
